{{rt|39|Johto}} }} '''Indubitably Ditto''' (Japanese: '''VS メタモン ''' ''VS {{tt|Metamon|Ditto}}''), titled '''VS Ditto''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 128th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 38th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On {{rt|38|Johto}}, Ken, Al, and Harry, of the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]], find {{p|Suicune}} and use their Pokémon to surround it. Meanwhile on {{rt|39|Johto}}, {{adv|Crystal}} and [[Eusine]] are attacked from behind by {{p|Ditto}}, as the Ditto had stretched part of its body underground while they were talking. Ditto stops Crystal from being able to reach her {{i|Poké Ball}}s, and Eusine attempts to use his {{p|Electrode}} to electrocute Ditto. However, Crystal reminds him that electrocuting Ditto would also electrocute them. While she thinks of a plan, Crystal is pulled completely inside of Ditto. Ditto gloats, but is quickly knocked out by a punch. As it releases Crystal, it is revealed that [[Monlee]] was the one who threw the punch, and that Crystal was crouched beneath him. Crystal had been able to send out her Pokémon, and have Monlee make a human shape for her, in order to confuse Ditto. Once Ditto is defeated, Crystal and Eusine decide to use the [[Pokédex]] tracking system to track down Suicune, and thus, the person who sent Ditto to distract them. Because of the speed in which Suicune and the people following it are moving, Crystal decides to have {{p|Parasect|Parasee}} use {{m|Spore}} at a specific range in order to stop them from chasing Suicune. Meanwhile on Route 38, Ken, Al, and Harry are chasing Suicune, when they are suddenly hit by Spore and fall asleep. Using Eusine's Electrode, Crystal and Eusine head towards Suicune's location. Once they are close to Suicune's location, Eusine hands Crystal a doll, and then leaves. Through the doll, he tells her that they should split up: one will go after Suicune, while the other will deal with [[Team Rocket]]. Crystal realizes that Suicune is heading towards [[Ecruteak City]], and decides to follow it. Meanwhile, Eusine finds Ken, Al, and Harry as they wake up. Eusine realizes that the {{p|Octillery}} he sees is who had used {{m|Ice Beam}} earlier. He decides to wait until the effects of Spore wear off before he takes them all in a battle. ==Major events== * {{adv|Crystal}} and [[Eusine]] defeat {{p|Ditto}}. * Eusine confronts [[Team Rocket]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Crystal}} * [[Eusine]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]] * [[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Arcanine}} ([[Archy]]; {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Parasect}} (Parasee; {{adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Hitmonchan}} ([[Monlee]], {{Adv|Crystal}}'s) * {{p|Electrode}} ([[Eusine]]'s) * {{p|Jumpluff}} ([[Eusine]]'s) * {{p|Elekid}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) * {{p|Octillery}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Ken]]'s) * {{p|Spinarak}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Al]]'s) * {{p|Girafarig}} ([[Team Rocket Elite Trio|Harry]]'s) * {{p|Ditto}} ([[Team Rocket]]'s) * {{p|Miltank}} ([[Moomoo Farm]]'s; multiple) * {{p|Suicune}} ({{DL|Legendary beasts (Adventures)|Suicune|Adventures}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 百變怪|VS Ditto}} (Taiwan)
